title: No SSE reconnection: TUI shows Reconnecting forever after stream closes
description: spawn_sse starts run_sse once and never retries. If the server closes the SSE stream (restart, network blip), the mpsc channel sender is dropped, sse_rx.recv() returns None, and connection_status is set to Reconnecting permanently. The TUI remains functional for typing but no new messages arrive. The user must quit and restart. Phase 1 trade-off is noted in a code comment but there is no user-visible hint that manual restart is required.
